item.subject: science
item.stem:
Chetan lists human actions that disturb Earth's living and non-living systems: burning fossil fuels that release greenhouse gases, which trap heat and cause global warming; destroying natural habitats with biodiversity loss; and releasing pollutants that cause pollution and harm ecosystems and people.

Which claim correctly states how these actions create major threats to life?

options.A: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases that trap more heat and cause global warming, while habitat destruction, biodiversity loss, and pollution harm ecosystems and people.
options.B: Greenhouse gases cool the planet, so burning fossil fuels protects life from heat.
options.C: Only pollution matters; habitat destruction and greenhouse gases do not threaten life.
options.D: Habitat destruction helps biodiversity by moving ecosystems and people into safer places.
